day_local: Sabtida Toddobaadka Afraad iyo Labaatanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Waxaan ku socon doonaa joogitaanka Ilaah, nuurka kuwa nool.
homily:
Bal qiyaas beerta weyn ee nolosheenna. Waxaan inta badan u malaynaa in nolosha ay tahay wax aan dhisno, wax aan maamulno, ama wax aan ku guulaysanno sida koodhka kumbuyuutarka ee uu Benjamin Vo si xariifnimo leh u qori jiray. Waxaan arkaa Ben oo fadhiya miiskiisa, isagoo si taxaddar leh u dhisaya aalad ama koodh, isagoo si qoto dheer ugu dhex milmay dunida tiknoolajiyadda. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo arko waxyaabaha aan la arki karin, sida loo fahmo qoto dheerida xogta iyo xiriirka ka dhexeeya qaybaha yaryar ee adduunkeenna. Laakiin maanta, Injiilka Luukas wuxuu ina xusuusinayaa wax ka sii qoto dheer qorshayaasha aadanaha: 'Abuuruhu wuxuu u baxay inuu beero midhihiisa.' 

Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in midhuhu ay ku dhacaan meelo kala duwan: waddo, dhagax, qodax, iyo carro wanaagsan. Markaan ka fikirno nolosha Benjamin, waxaan aragnaa wiil ahaa 'carro wanaagsan.' Wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbigiisu u furnaa si uu u arko waxyaabaha aan la arki karin. Wuxuu arkayay quruxda, wuxuu arkayay baahida dadka kale, wuxuuna arkayay jacaylka Ilaah oo ku dhex jira adduunkan. Xusuuso markuu ahaa 15 sano jir, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa jacayl aan xisaab lahayn, jacayl aan sugin mahadcelin, jacayl si fudud u bixiya naftiisa. 

Bawlos wuxuu akhriska koowaad inoo sheegayaa xaqiiqo naxdin leh haddii aynaan rumaysnayn sarakicidda: 'Waxaa lagu beeray daciifnimo, waxaa loo sara kiciyay awood.' Tani waa tiirka nolosheenna. Markaan eegno dhimashada Benjamin, waxaan dareemaynaa in dunidu ay mararka qaarkood u muuqato mid aan macno lahayn. Laakiin Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in jidhkeennu uu yahay sida 'kernel' ama midho la beeray. Waxa la beeray maaha waxa soo baxaya. Waxaa la beeray midho dhimanaya, laakiin waxaa la sara kiciyay midho weligood nool. 

Alan iyo Thao, saddex bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii Ben uu u gudbay nolosha kale, June 13, 2026. Waxaan ogahay in gurigiina uu leeyahay aamusnaan aan la sharxi karin. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii Alan, xanaanadii Thao—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa. 

Bal xusuuso riyadii aad aragtay, Alan, markii Ben uu kuu sheegay: 'Ba, test-ka waan ka gudbay. Con tự thở được bình thường mà…' Ben wuxuu xor ka yahay culeyskii jirka. Wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon. Wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.' 

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waxaan ogahay inaysan fududayn inaad lumiso saaxiibkaaga, walaalkaa, kii aad la wadaagaysay adduunka. Laakiin Ben wuxuu kaa doonayaa inaad sii waddo socodka, inaad noolaato adigoo geesinimo leh, adigoo xusuusanaya in xiriirka idinka dhexeeya uusan dhiman. 

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, oo aad igu xirto adiga weligaa. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabad. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay, ha ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiixa.
Qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culeyska wada, ha heleen raaxo iyo rajo ay ka helaan jacaylka Ilaah.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, qof baa laga yaabaa inuu yiraahdo, 'Sidee baa kuwii dhintay loo sara kiciyaa? Jidh noocee ah ayay ku soo noqonayaan?' Doqonyahow! Waxa aad beeraysaa ma noolaanayo haddii uusan dhiman. Waxa aad beeraysaa maaha jidhka iman doona, laakiin waa midho, tusaale ahaan sarreen ama nooc kale. Sidoo kale waa sarakicidda kuwii dhintay. Waxaa lagu beeray qudhun, waxaa loo sara kiciyay mid aan qudhmayn. Waxaa lagu beeray ceeb, waxaa loo sara kiciyay ammaan. Waxaa lagu beeray daciifnimo, waxaa loo sara kiciyay awood. Waxaa lagu beeray jidh dabiici ah, waxaa loo sara kiciyay jidh ruuxi ah. Haddii uu jiro jidh dabiici ah, waxaa kaloo jira mid ruuxi ah. Sidaas oo kale ayaa qoran, 'Ninkii ugu horreeyay, Aadan, wuxuu noqday naf nool,' Aadan-kii dambe wuxuu noqday ruux wax nooleeya. Laakiin ruuxigu ma ahayn kii ugu horreeyay; waxaa jiray kii dabiiciga ahaa ka dibna kii ruuxiga ahaa. Ninkii ugu horreeyay wuxuu ka yimid dhulka, wuxuu ahaa dhul; ninkii labaad wuxuu ka yimid jannada. Sida kii dhulka ahaa, ayay yihiin kuwa dhulka, iyo sida kii jannada ahaa, ayay yihiin kuwa jannada. Sida aynu u qaadannay muuqaalkii kii dhulka, waxaan sidoo kale qaadan doonnaa muuqaalkii kii jannada.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Waxaan ku socon doonaa joogitaanka Ilaah, nuurka kuwa nool. Hadda waan ogahay in Ilaah ila jiro. Ilaah, oo aan ballanqaadkiisa ku faano, Ilaah ayaan ku aaminay cabsi la'aan; maxay jidhku iga qaadi kartaa? R. Waxaan ku socon doonaa joogitaanka Ilaah, nuurka kuwa nool. Waxaan kugu xirnaaday nidarro, Ilaahow; waan fulin doonaa qurbaannadaada mahadnaqa. Waayo waad iga samatabbixisay dhimashada, cagahaygana waad iga badbaadisay turunturo; si aan ugu socdo Ilaah hortiisa nuurka kuwa nool. R. Waxaan ku socon doonaa joogitaanka Ilaah, nuurka kuwa nool.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markii dad badan ay isugu yimaadeen, oo ay ka imanayeen magaalooyin kala duwan, Ciise wuxuu u sheegay masaal. 'Beeralay baa u baxay inuu beero midhihiisa. Markuu beerayay, qayb waxay ku dhacday jidka dhinaciisa, waana la tuntay, haadkii cirkiina way cuneen. Qayb waxay ku dhacday dhagax, markay baxdayna way engegtay waayo qoyaan ma lahayn. Qayb waxay ku dhacday qodax, qodaxdiina way la baxday wayna ceejisay. Qayb waxay ku dhacday carro wanaagsan, markay baxdayna waxay dhashay boqol laab.' Markuu tan yidhi, wuxuu ku dhawaaqay, 'Kii dhego u leh ha maqlo.' Xertiisiina waxay weydiiyeen waxa masaalku yahay. Wuxuu ugu jawaabay, 'Aqoonta qarsoon ee Boqortooyada Ilaah waxaa la idin siiyay; laakiin kuwa kale waxaa loogu sheegaa masaallo si ay u eegaan laakiin aysan u arkin, u maqlaan laakiin aysan u fahmin. Tani waa macnaha masaalka. Midhaha waa kelmedda Ilaah. Kuwa jidka dhinaciisa waa kuwa maqlay, laakiin Shaydaanka ayaa yimaada oo kelmedda ka qaada qalbiyadooda si aysan u rumaysan oo aysan u badbaadin. Kuwa dhagaxa ku dhacay waa kuwa marka ay maqlaan, ku qaata farxad, laakiin xidid ma laha; waxay rumaystaan wakhti yar, markii imtixaanku yimaadana way dhacaan. Midhaha qodaxa ku dhacay waa kuwa maqlay, laakiin intay socdaan, waxaa ceejiya walwalka, hodantinimada, iyo raaxada nolosha, mana soo saaraan midho bisil. Laakiin kuwa carro wanaagsan ku dhacay waa kuwa markay maqlaan kelmedda, ku qabsada qalbi deeqsi iyo wanaagsan, oo midho u dhala dulqaadkooda.'

day: Saturday of the Twenty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
